text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—It seems the time has come to put our 
grand ambitions into action.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haha. I have already devised a strategy, 
my lord.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Fukujin Castle," "Kuhou Castle." And then 
"Noshimaru Castle." I was thinking these 
might be good places to target first.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. If we conquer those castles, that 
land is as good as ours. As expected of my 
strategist!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
If that be the case... As swift as the 
wind! We shall conquer them all in one 
fell swoop!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Well now, my liege. I thought it 
might be wise to take our time with this 
offensive~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Noshimaru Castle in particular is famous 
for its unique secrets. Taking your time 
to slowly and thoroughly lay siege to it 
is certainly a viable option, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu, you are quite a greedy one as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, no. Not nearly as much as you, my 
lord...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Alright... Let's do it this weekend! We're 
launching our okonomiyaki restaurant tour!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... This is getting so exciting!
